description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe standing in front of pile of stacked firewood;  three-quarter length view, head turned slightly to viewer right  with eyes looking down, hair pulled back from face into a bun, hands clasped together below waist, collared long-sleeve buttoned jacket with pockets worn over blouse and skirt; all garments similarly colored, Alexander Calder brooch on viewer right lapel. Upper half of photo uneven tonal range.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe, Abiquiu
